summary: Frontend-only testing of new SB Assistant feature (AI shopping assistant powered by Gemini 3 Flash). All 4 scenarios PASSED. Login → /assistant page renders correctly, /food entry button navigates, pizza query returns 3 grounded products from Pizza Heaven with real prices in €, restaurant query returns 5 merchant cards with Ouvert/Fermé badges + rating, and the 'canapé en cuir' query gracefully returns an empty result with no hallucinated products. Product card click correctly navigates to /food/merchant_pizza_heaven.

issues: Minor: suggestion testid for 'Un restaurant ouvert' is data-testid='assistant-suggestion-Un resta' (truncated to first 8 chars via s.slice(0,8)) — review_request mentioned 'Un resto'. Cosmetic only; fallback by typing message works.

critical_code_review_comments: AssistantPage.jsx: suggestion testids use s.slice(0,8) which yields 'Un resta', 'Je veux ', 'Un vin r', 'Une épic'. Consider full-string testid (e.g. slugify) for clearer selectors.
AssistantPage.jsx: assistant-msg-assistant-<index> uses array index — if messages list grows or is mutated, indices remain stable (append-only) so OK, but cleaner to use a stable msg id.
AssistantPage.jsx send(): no abort/timeout on fetch — long-running Gemini calls can hang the UI; consider AbortController with ~20s timeout and a user-visible error.
Empty input + Enter dispatches send() which is no-op (good). Send button disable state properly bound to loading and !input.trim().
test_credentials: Client: test2@example.com / TestPass123! (verified working via email-password flow accessed through 'Ou choisir une autre option de connexion' → 'Email & mot de passe').
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login flow: from /login, click 'Ou choisir une autre option de connexion' → 'Email & mot de passe' → fill data-testid=email-input & password-input → click 'Se connecter'. /assistant route + open-assistant-btn on /food both functional. Gemini calls take ~3-8s; allow up to 20s. Catalog small: pizza/restaurant/vin/épicerie return grounded results; canapé/baguette correctly return empty.
